proof_summary: Take \(n=51\), which satisfies \(51\equiv1\pmod 5\) and gives \(138n+6=7044\). The congruences \(2^{7044}+2\equiv206\pmod{233}\), \(2^{233}\equiv1\pmod{1399}\), and \(2^{206}\equiv-3\pmod{1399}\) show that \(1399\) divides \(2^{2^{7044}+2}+3\), so its least prime factor is at most \(1399<1669\).
